decision: Keep ML Kit as bundled default. Offer the official PP-OCRv5 Mobile pack as optional because this photo improves, without a general accuracy claim. Model data is outside the APK.

focusedCheck.initialHarnessCorrection: Prepared QUEUED tasks must be scheduled rather than retried; corrected test harness and cancelled active records in cleanup. Recognition itself passed on the first run.

limits: Only zh/en pack supplied; no unsupported-language selector
Paddle output has line quads/confidence only, no fabricated per-word boxes
One detection then recognition batches of one; existing ML Kit multi-pass enhancements do not imply Paddle voting
Native heap snapshots are before/after observations, not peak RSS or a phone performance benchmark
Full document backups retain OCR/text/version and chosen settings; optional model weights are separately imported
